title: The IndieWeb, Revolution, and Other Reasons You Should Learn to Code – The Electric Abacus
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Bookmarked: The IndieWeb, Revolution, and Other Reasons You Should Learn to Code – The Electric Abacus

https://electricabacus.net/2014/03/25/the-indieweb-revolution-and-other-reasons-you-should-learn-to-code/

Now I’m not a Web Developer, but I think I’d like to try my hand at it. I don’t need to centralize all of my data but I would like an online presence that I control. Something that I could constantly work on. Something that’s never finished. Much like the web itself.

 

An example of someone being invited into the #IndieWeb and shared values among the community
